claims.claim: Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 confirm the camera model and lens focal length.
The report does not mention the camera being powered on or tested.
Photo 2 shows the rubber grip on the camera body is heavily worn and peeling.

risks.risk: High shutter count indicating heavy use
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from the last photo's EXIF data.
A clear photo of the lens glass with a light shining through it.
A photo of a plain white wall taken at a high aperture (f/22).
A photo of the rear LCD screen powered on.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear LCD screen powered on
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements
Photo of the battery and charger
response.reason: The item identity is confirmed, but the visible wear on the grip contradicts the seller's claims. It will be priced at its worst-case functional condition until further proof is provided.
